CSS & COLOR

HEX to RGBA converter

Turn a HEX color into RGBA with an explicit opacity. Preview the color over light and dark backgrounds, copy CSS, and compare its nearest 8-digit HEX value.

HEX color + opacitysRGB channels · runs locally

3, 4, 6 or 8 digits, with or without #. In CSS, alpha comes last.

Use 0 for transparent and 1 for opaque. A 4- or 8-digit value supplies its own alpha.

TRY A COMPLETE EXAMPLE

Light backgroundDark background

RGBA opacity 0.5 maps to alpha byte 128/255 in HEX.

CSS EXAMPLE
.overlay {
  background-color: rgba(36, 76, 218, 0.5);
}
A LITTLE CONTEXT

How to convert HEX to RGBA

Enter a color, then set an opacity from 0 to 1. A 6-digit color gives the red, green and blue bytes; opacity supplies the fourth RGBA component. An 8-digit color already contains alpha, so the separate opacity control is disabled.

#RRGGBB + opacity → rgba(R, G, B, opacity)

References: MDN: HEX color syntax · MDN: element opacity

Good to know

Where is alpha in an 8-digit CSS HEX color?

CSS uses #RRGGBBAA: the last two digits are alpha. #33669980 contains red 51, green 102, blue 153 and alpha 128/255, approximately 0.501961. Formats that put alpha first are different; rearrange them before using this converter.

Does #80 mean exactly 50% opacity?

No. Hexadecimal 80 is decimal 128. Dividing by 255 gives approximately 0.501961. An RGBA opacity of 0.5 is exact as written; its nearest 8-bit HEX alpha is 80. This page preserves a separately entered RGBA opacity and explains the small HEX rounding difference.

What does a 4-digit color mean?

Each digit is doubled: #0f08 becomes #00ff0088. Its green channel is 255 and its opacity is 136/255, about 0.533333. This is shorthand for four channels, not a shortened six-digit color.

Why is the preview different over white and dark backgrounds?

A partially transparent color is composited with whatever is behind it. The converter shows the same foreground over two backgrounds; it does not change the RGB channels or bake the background into the output.

Is alpha the same as the CSS opacity property?

Alpha affects the color value where you use it, such as background-color. Setting opacity on an element also affects the rendered element and its contents, including text and children. Use a color alpha when only that painted color should be translucent.

Can I paste an rgba() function or convert back?

This entry point accepts HEX and a separate decimal opacity. For separate RGB/RGBA channel input and reverse conversion, use the HEX to RGB tool. Named colors, HSL and wide-gamut color spaces are outside this page’s input format.

PRACTICAL REFERENCE

8-digit HEX and opacity, step by step

Use the same color in both notations, while keeping the alpha rounding visible.

StepValueMeaning
Split #33669933 · 66 · 99One pair per color channel
Read decimal channels51 · 102 · 153Each byte ranges from 0 to 255
Choose opacity0.5RGBA keeps the chosen value
Find the closest alpha byteround(0.5 × 255) = 128 = 808-bit HEX must choose a whole byte
Compare outputsrgba(51, 102, 153, 0.5)
#33669980		Nearly, but not exactly, the same alpha

Use HEX to RGB when you want decimal color channels without adding opacity, or when you need reverse RGB input. That converter keeps its RGBA display aligned with the rounded HEX byte; this entry point keeps a separately entered opacity in the primary RGBA result. Both show their assumptions.

For a translucent background, apply background-color: rgba(51, 102, 153, 0.5) to the element. Applying opacity: 0.5 instead also fades its text and children. Neither this preview nor a valid color code establishes accessible contrast; test the actual foreground, background and text together.
